tasks.title: The counters factory: in memory and in a shared store behind one contract
tasks.dod: Both implementations pass one set of assertions about the contract; the check that two independent instances see the same number goes red on the process-local implementation

tasks.title: The fact-store factory: the stage 5 file and a database behind one set of methods
tasks.dod: Both implementations pass one set of assertions; stage 5 is not changed by a single line, its 42 checks stay green

tasks.title: Migration: the facts table with the owner in the key
tasks.dod: The migration applies and rolls back cleanly; the owner filter is a condition of the query, not filtering in memory

tasks.title: Three guards: the key, the rate, the budget — three different refusals
tasks.dod: Each refusal differs from the others both in the response and in the metrics; none of them reaches the model; the key appears neither in the log, nor in the trace, nor in the response

tasks.title: The intent classifier: one branch per call
tasks.dod: Three different requests give three different branches; the branch lands in the trace as the first step; the error on a compound request is named with a number rather than in words

tasks.title: Health and metrics: the health of every dependency separately
tasks.dod: Health names every dependency separately and is available with no key; the metrics are closed behind a key and tell the kinds of failure apart; a broken dependency gives a named error rather than a crash

tasks.title: The wiring: the guards, the branch, memory, the agent, the request's trace
tasks.dod: The trace carries the service's steps in execution order, each with a reason; a trace is found by its identifier; app.py is ≤ 120 executable lines

tasks.title: The two-worker trap: the scheduler inside and in its own process
tasks.dod: With the flag on, the job runs twice per interval and that is visible as a number; with it off, once; the same pair is proved for the rate limit

tasks.title: Deployment: the production build, a TLS proxy, the smoke script
tasks.dod: smoke.sh runs the same list against localhost and against the domain, gives zero on a healthy build and non-zero on a broken one; the check on a public certificate is marked NOT EVALUATED without a machine

tasks.title: Demo: the scenes against the service with no network
tasks.dod: The demo works with no key and no containers; every scene leaves a trail in the output and a step in the trace; the e2e check asserts the scenes' bodies, not their headers

tasks.title: Checks up to full coverage of the table, and the mutations
tasks.dod: Each of the 22 criteria has a check; the share of failure modes is ≥ 1/3; the suite is green or NOT EVALUATED without Docker, none red; every mutation is caught by the check that asserts about it

tasks.title: The lesson, the English map, exercises, the checklist, the solutions
tasks.dod: The lesson is ≤ 2500 words; every number in the prose is reconciled by a check; the exercises have measured counts of red; the checklist covers three levels

tasks.title: The glossary, the statuses and the architecture map
tasks.dod: The stage's terms in GLOSSARY; the status updated in CURRICULUM and README; docs/architecture-map.md reflects the system rather than the skeleton
